site.name: Job Radar
site.title: Job Radar — senior engineering roles in India
site.tagline: Senior+ engineering roles in India (or remote-India) at employers vetted to pay top of market. Crawled daily straight from company ATS boards.
site.description: Daily-updated senior+ engineering roles in India (or remote-India) at companies vetted to pay at least ₹50L base at senior level.
about: Companies: a hand-vetted list; each employer must clear ₹20L base pay generally and ₹50L base at senior level in India. Company bands are recorded with sources in the repo and refined by pay data observed in real postings.

Roles: senior+ engineering titles only (Senior / Staff / Principal / Lead / Architect / Director / EM / VP). Where pay is published, the band's lower bound must clear ₹50L base; equity and bonus never count. Where pay is not published, the company's vetted senior band applies.
Geography: India-located, remote-India, and unrestricted-remote roles (the latter flagged "verify eligibility"). Roles restricted to other regions are excluded.
Freshness: crawled daily from public ATS boards. A role leaves the active list after two consecutive successful crawls without it, and lives on in the archive. Failed crawls never remove anything.

pay.fxNote: Conservative (rounded down against the employee); reviewed quarterly.
